breakdown.description: Otto cycle is defined incorrectly (Otto has constant-volume heat addition, not constant-pressure).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim: 'An Otto cycle has constant-pressure heat addition.' The Otto cycle has constant-volume heat addition; constant-pressure heat addition defines a Diesel cycle. This was not corrected.

breakdown.description: Efficiency formula is applied for a different cycle than described.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still applies eta = 1 - 1/r^(gamma-1) (the Otto cycle formula) to a process described as having constant-pressure heat addition (which is a Diesel cycle). The ground truth states that the Diesel efficiency formula should be used for constant-pressure heat addition. This mismatch was not resolved.
